body:
Hi, the Quillstream connector fails at the OAuth step with 'invalid_client'. Can you help?

Priya Shah
Harbor Freightworks

Hi Priya, the client secret had been rotated on the Quillstream side. Re-authorizing fixed it. Closing this one out.

Rita

Our Quillpad sync gets throttled every morning. What is Quillpad's rate limit on the Pro plan?

Priya Sharma
Kettle & Co

Is it possible to connect a second Quillstream workspace to the same account?

Tomas

Hello,

Since this morning our Quillstream sync fails with 429 Too Many Requests. We're on Quillstream's Business plan. How many requests per minute does Quillstream actually allow on Business? We want to tune our sync schedule so we stay under it.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Harbor Freightworks
Our connector is fine, they're hitting Quillstream's own limit. Someone needs to check the current number in Quillstream's docs before we reply. Careful, their v2 docs are still online.
